internal_prior_evidence.claim: Exact accepted-target Ubuntu SQLite 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 is WAL-reset-vulnerable and a private SQLite 3.53.4 runtime candidate is justified.
V1 version/source-id/mapped-object/hash admission is a sufficient product runtime object-identity boundary.

live_external_evidence.source: GNU C Library dynamic linker / ld.so documentation
live_external_evidence.claim_used: LD_PRELOAD can load objects before other shared objects and provides an interposition surface; hardened deployment should avoid dynamic-linker environment dependence and symbol interposition where possible.
Compile-time options can materially change SQLite runtime behavior and are introspectable separately from source identity.
sqlite3_sourceid identifies source provenance and is not, by itself, a complete compile/runtime behavior identity.

hypothesis: A same-version and same-source-id SQLite shared object built from the same official 3.53.4 source can interpose the sqlite3 API through LD_PRELOAD under a renamed basename while FRANK_FIXED_SQLITE_RUNTIME_V1 still hashes and admits the expected libsqlite3 mapping.
strongest_counterhypothesis: V1's re-exec plus mapped-object/version/source-id/hash checks already fail closed before target execution whenever another SQLite provider interposes the API.

oob_adjudication.reason: The expected private libsqlite object was mapped and hash/source-id/version-correct, yet pysqlite behavior came from the renamed same-source-id preloaded provider.

mechanism_delta: deny a preexisting globally visible sqlite3 provider before intentional candidate load
set child LD_LIBRARY_PATH to exactly the pinned candidate directory
repeat loader-cleanliness checks in the fresh child before pysqlite import

architecture_delta.supersede: Do not promote FRANK_FIXED_SQLITE_RUNTIME_V1 as a sufficient correctness-sensitive SQLite process-binding proof.
architecture_delta.retain: Private official SQLite 3.53.4 remains the target-supported fixed WAL-reset runtime candidate; the exact Ubuntu 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 system runtime remains rejected for the targeted defect class.
architecture_delta.candidate_successor: FRANK_FIXED_SQLITE_RUNTIME_V2_CANDIDATE is target-supported for the specifically reproduced preexisting/global loader-interposition class.
required_next_gates: trusted-launch/deployment boundary that does not treat Python-level checks as protection from hostile pre-main constructors
immutable build/manifest provenance bound to owner-accepted builder/source policy
restart/recovery and broader UnifiedDB/V17/GWT/effect suites under the exact V2-admitted runtime
power-loss/kernel-panic durability remains a separate discriminator
composition into current main before any release promotion

negative_results_preserved: V1 7/7 ordinary admission controls were insufficient against same-source-id renamed ELF interposition.
A correct source-id does not uniquely identify the active compiled provider behavior.
A correctly mapped and correctly hashed expected libsqlite object does not prove its symbols are the ones actually serving pysqlite when another earlier provider can interpose.

duplicate_work_avoided.decision: DO_NOT_DUPLICATE; route storage result only where dependency-relevant
